outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, cesarean delivery)
cohort: Low-risk women with singleton pregnancies who underwent induction of labor between 37 and 42 weeks of gestation were included.
finding: Induction of labor between 37+0 and 37+6 weeks gestation showed the maximum proportion of vaginal deliveries and the least proportion of adverse fetal outcomes, while IOL at 40+0 to 40+6 weeks was associated with the highest rates of cesarean delivery and fetal distress.
mod_finding: The highest proportion of vaginal deliveries was observed between 37+0 and 37+6 weeks (77.9%), whereas the highest proportion of cesarean deliveries (39.8%) was noted between 40+0 and 40+6 weeks.
